name: io.github.fetter-io/fetter-mcp
title: Fetter MCP
description: Real-time package and vulnerability data (Python, npm, Cargo, Go, and more) for AI coding agents.

tools.name: is_vulnerable
tools.description: Check if a specific package version has known vulnerabilities. Requires an exact version: 'requests==2.31.0' for Python (the default ecosystem), or 'name@version' for other ecosystems (e.g., 'lodash@4.17.15' with ecosystem 'npm').

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem: "python" (default), "npm", "cargo", "gha", "vscode", "go", "ruby", "php", or "swift". Call `list_ecosystems` for name formats and examples.

name.description: The exact package name and version. For Python, use "==" (e.g., "requests==2.31.0"). For other ecosystems, use "name@version" (e.g., "lodash@4.17.15", "time@=0.1.43", "tj-actions/changed-files@v35").

tools.name: list_ecosystems
tools.description: List the package ecosystems this server supports, with the default ecosystem, each ecosystem's registry, its package name format, and example names.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Look up a package by name and (optionally) version requirement to find which versions are available and/or have vulnerabilities. Supports multiple ecosystems via `ecosystem` (default: python).

cvss_filter.description:
CVSS score filter: "all" to show all vulnerabilities, "max" to show only the
maximum observed score, or a number (0.0-10.0) to filter by threshold

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem: "python" (default), "npm", "cargo", "gha", "vscode", "go", "ruby", "php", or "swift". Call `list_ecosystems` for name formats and examples.

limit.description: When the name is not an exact version, limit the number of recent versions to check.

name.description: The package name with an optional requirement. For Python, a PEP 508 specifier (e.g., "requests", "numpy>=2.0", "flask==3.0.0"). For other ecosystems, "name" or "name@requirement" in the ecosystem's native syntax (e.g., "lodash@>=4.17.15 <4.17.22", "serde@^1.0", "actions/checkout"). Note that when an exact version is specified, the `limit` and `retain_passing` parameters have no effect.

retain_passing.description: When the name is not an exact version, setting this to true will return references for all versions, including those with no vulnerabilities (default: false)

tools.name: most_recent_not_vulnerable
tools.description: Find the most recent version of a package that has no known vulnerabilities. Supports multiple ecosystems via `ecosystem` (default: python).

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem: "python" (default), "npm", "cargo", "gha", "vscode", "go", "ruby", "php", or "swift". Call `list_ecosystems` for name formats and examples.

name.description: The package name to look up. For Python, a name only (e.g., "requests"). For other ecosystems, a name (e.g., "lodash", "serde", "actions/checkout"), optionally with an "@requirement" range to search within.
